task_description: Add a WorshipTools-style Home screen (Quick start + Upcoming services + '+ Add a new service') as the default center panel, and repoint the Services top-nav tab to a full Services-list table (Date | Type | Title | Last modified | Last modified by) with search, filters, '+ New Service', per-row overflow menu, and row-click load. Implements .agents/tasks/home-services-screens/design.md faithfully.
